gizmo.title: Mawu odutsana
gizmo.description: Mawu odutsana opangidwa kuchokera ku mndandanda wa mawu ndi zidziwitso. Gululi limapangidwa m'malo mwanu; ophunzira amalemba mawu ndi kuwayang'ana.

configure.title: Mutu
configure.description: Mutu kapena funso lowonetsedwa pamwamba pa mawu odutsana.

configure.title: Mawu
configure.description: Liwu lililonse ndi chidziwitso chake. Gululi limapangidwa kuchokera ku mndandanda uwu: liwu lalitali kwambiri limayikidwa koyamba ndipo enawo amalidutsa pa zilembo zogawana.

advanced.title: Kuyesa
advanced.description: Kangati wophunzira angayang'ane. 0 imatanthauza mopanda malire.

advanced.title: Mtundu wowonetsa
advanced.description: Mtundu wosankha wa chizindikiro cha pamutu, liwu logwira ntchito ndi mabatani a zochita.

advanced.title: Yopindika
advanced.description: Onetsani mawu odutsana awa ngati mzere womwe umatseguka ndi kutseka. Kutsegula limodzi kumatseka mafunso ena opindika omwe ali pafupi nalo.

advanced.title: Yambani mopindidwa
advanced.description: Ikakhala yopindika, yambani ngati mzere wotsekedwa womwe umawonetsa mutu ndi momwe zilili kokha.

advanced.title: Mtundu wa kupereka magiredi
advanced.description: OER Schema: mtundu wa kupereka magiredi pa kuyesa uku (mwachitsanzo mapointi, chilembo, peresenti, kumaliza).

advanced.title: Cholinga cha maphunziro
advanced.description: OER Schema: cholinga cha maphunziro chogwirizana ndi kuyesa uku.

developer.title: Dzina la mayeso
developer.description: Dzina la mayeso logwiritsidwa ntchito pozindikiritsa xAPI m'machitidwe owunika.

developer.title: Maphunziro
